item.title: TTT 42: Two and a Half Podcasts
item.description:
Eric thinks that both Charlie Sheen and John Cryer can go fuck themselves for signing up for another season of “Two and a half men”.  Rachelle thinks Eric is  being too angry about the stupid show but agrees with him that whoever is responsible for “Ace Ventura Jr.” can suck it. Episode Links:
